risk_note: RV2 (funds). adminBatchManualPaid implements W8, new money logic (BR-WDR-16, 09, 17, 33; D10-595, D10-596). While a channel's transfer interface is not open this is the way a withdrawal ends. Each item on its own transaction: locks users, balance, withdrawal row; checks in the contract's order; CAS APPROVED to PAID_MANUAL with paid_at as given, both manual_*_by the caller and the hold cleared; the same WITHDRAW:SUCCESS voucher as W5 by snapshot channel; tax_ytd; wallet.withdrawal_changed; audit. EXECUTE and W8 exclude each other by the row lock and the CAS, the first to commit wins. A serial number lost to the unique index and a member without a verified real name surface as throws, which roll the item back and become that item's result, not a 5xx. Existing code moved, not changed: memberWithdrawalBlocked out of payout-execute.ts and readPayerSideQueryRefusal out of withdrawal-commands.ts, so W8 uses the same guards; CASH_SUBJECT, PAYER_SIDE_HOLD and postingEntries are exported from withdrawal-proven-success.ts. The contract's channel_order_id pattern also refuses NUL, which the database cannot store. No migration: couli_app already has the column grants. Known and not done here: the query path for withdrawals returned by W9 (D10-596, D); the console has no button or serial number import yet (fe).

reviews.note: Independent Claude via claude-run.sh under approvals 36, Codex not logged in (401). couli-runs/B2-09m/money-review-r1.json, static, nothing executed. One S2, fixed after it with no second money round: a serial number with NUL would have ended the request in 5xx at the database; the contract's pattern now refuses it at the route with a rule test (#81). Reviewed before the rule tests were strengthened and before the rebase; apart from that pattern and its generated files the implementation did not change.

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude each round, static, not run by the reviewer. r1 fail with 3 S1, all tests that could not catch a wrong implementation: reading only the newest attempt, reading available outside the balance lock, and withdraw.enabled stopping W8. A new independent Claude added #77 to #81 in a new file, no existing assertion changed. pay mutated withdrawal-manual-paid.ts twice, both restored: reading only the newest attempt turned only #77 and #78 red; reading available before lockBalances turned only #79 red, a member_blocked withdrawal answered paid. A first attempt at the second mutation was itself broken (every test 500) and was discarded. r2 on the increment pass with no findings.
